programme.title: Aavishkar

programme.title: Dhamaal

programme.title: Firaaq
programme.desc: Inspired from the 2002 violence in Gujarat, this drama follows the lives of different people directly or indirectly affected by the riots, from a compassionate woman in an orthodox Gujarati family living with a stone-hearted husband, an urban cross-culture couple with a Hindu wife and a Muslim husband, a poor Muslim couple whose house is charred to ashes during the riots to an old Muslim singer. As their stories unfold and intertwine, we see the harrowing picture of the repercussions of violence in society.

programme.title: Fiffty Fiffty
programme.desc: Bihari's (Om Shivpuri) father loses his ancestral estate to Virendra Singh's (Ranjeet) family, who now live on the land in a palatial house. Singh has a son named Kishan (Rajesh Khanna). Bihari feels that they do not deserve the riches and sets out to swap his own infant son with Kishan. An attempt to stop him is made by Virendra, who gets killed. Bihari's wife tries to stop her husband but is unable to do so. Bihari thus manages to hide the truth from everyone. He hands over Kishan to his brother in Mumbai and introduces him to the life of crime, then watches as his own son grows up surrounded by riches. Will they ever find the truth about their lineage?

programme.title: SP Chauhan: A Struggling Man
